dct_description_sm:
This dataset provides the location of Yukon's education facilities ranging from elementary to post-seondary education. The data also includes contact information and general programming information about each facility.

Distributed from GeoYukon by the Government of Yukon. Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:%20geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
